title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to "North Dakota Field Office Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan".
short_title: Repeal of the Bureau of Land Management rule on North Dakota Field Office Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Pl…
committees: S-Energy and Natural Resources Committee: Referred To 2025-07-10 -> Discharged From 2025-10-07
latest_action: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 180.
summary: This joint resolution nullifies the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) relating to the Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan (RMP) for the North Dakota Field Office and issued on January 8, 2025.  By way of background, an RMP guides the management of lands administered by BLM. The 2025 North Dakota RMP modified the 1988 RMP, including by limiting development of oil and gas in low-potential areas and new coal leasing to areas within four miles of existing mines.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
